body:
SOURCE: agy cross-model review of PR #497 (seam 6), round 1, medium severity, confidence 0.9, verdict still approve (non-blocking). The claim: plugins/adlc-claude-code hook wrapper code evaluates `process.argv[1]` during module evaluation (bin/direct-execution detection), and a non-existent or virtual argv[1] path (bundlers, REPL embedding, test runners with virtual entry points) raises an uncaught ENOENT at import time.

WHY IT MATTERS HERE SPECIFICALLY: seam 6 (PR #497) established that for ENFORCING hooks only exit 2 blocks in Claude Code — an uncaught crash exits 1, which is the FAIL-OPEN path the seam existed to close. An import-time crash would bypass the seam-6 fix entirely, because the dispatch/timeout handling never runs.

BUILD

1. FIRST verify the premise against the current wrapper (2026-08-14 lesson: two of three agy findings that day were refuted against the real code; this one arrived with hallucination-prone evidence formatting). Reproduce with a spawned node whose argv[1] is (a) a non-existent path and (b) a directory, importing the wrapper module. If it does NOT throw, close this ticket as refuted with the reproduction output pasted into the close note — that is a valid completion.
2. If it throws: make bin-detection failure-safe (wrap the filesystem probe; unknown/virtual argv[1] means 'not directly executed', never a throw), AND add a top-level import-time guard so that any unexpected evaluation error in the ENFORCING wrapper still results in exit 2 with a deny message on stderr — the fail-closed direction seam 6 defined.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

- AC1: spawning the wrapper with a non-existent argv[1] and enforcing-hook input yields exit 2 and a deny message, not an uncaught exception trace with exit 1. Verify: new test in plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/, named in the build.
- AC2: normal direct execution and normal hook dispatch behave exactly as before (the seam-6 suite, 172 tests, stays green unmodified). Verify: node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/
- AC3: suite green: npm test.

NOTES FOR THE BUILDER

- plugins/adlc-claude-code/** is a rails deny-path of base ticket T37, so this tiers trust-root and needs a distinct-provider cross-model approve.
- No rails declared here (2026-08-14 lesson); freeze tests in-session during the build.
title: CC wrapper: an import-time failure in bin detection must deny (exit 2), never crash fail-open
